description_en: Resets the state of a specific agent in a specific instance
description_zh: 调用ResetAgentState重置指定实例下指定坐席的坐席状态
kebab_example: aliyun ccc reset-agent-state --instance-id ccc-test --user-id agent@ccc-test --device-id device --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ResetAgentState

parameters.description_en: The ID of the Cloud Call Center (CCC) instance.

parameters.description_en: The ID of the agent. This parameter is optional. If omitted, the agent mapped to the current RAM account is reset.
parameters.description_zh: 坐席ID，非必填，不填默认使用当前RAM账户映射的坐席。
